text: You should not need to type an event code any more. Tap Sense Event and nearby events now appear as cards — tap one to start recording. A card marked Verified is the app agreeing with the registry; a card without that is shown but cannot be tapped, which is intended. If no card appears, the code entry is still there below the list, and we want to hear which one you had to use. Still open from earlier builds: connect a wallet with MetaMask, approve one signature, and confirm the app returns on its own.
